name: Multi-omics integrative clustering benchmark for colorectal cancer
description: A benchmarking study and associated dataset that evaluates integrative clustering methods for identifying molecular subtypes in colorectal cancer across multiple omics modalities.
evaluation_method: clustering agreement metrics (Adjusted Rand Index, NMI) plus biological validation (survival association / enrichment)
reputation: A domain-specific benchmark used by cancer bioinformatics groups to compare multi-omics integrative clustering methods; moderately cited in subtype-discovery studies.
notes: Multi-omics data are prone to batch effects and cohort heterogeneity; evaluation often requires external clinical/biological validation and results can depend strongly on preprocessing choices.
